exports.name: ToastAction
exports.description: A button inside the toast; `altText` tells screen readers how to do it without the toast.

props.name: altText
props.description:
A short description for an alternate way to carry out the action. For screen reader users
who will not be able to navigate to the button easily/quickly.

exports.name: ToastClose

exports.name: ToastProvider
exports.description:
Brief, non-blocking notices ("Message sent", "Update available"). Put one
`ToastProvider` + `ToastViewport` near the root and render `Toast`s with
`open` state; Radix handles timing, swipe-to-dismiss and the live region.

props.name: announcerContainer
props.description:
An optional container where the toast announcements should be appended.
This is useful when working with focus traps or modal dialogs that make
other elements inert.

props.name: duration
props.description: Time in milliseconds that each toast should remain visible for.

props.name: label
props.description:
An author-localized label for each toast. Used to help screen reader users
associate the interruption with a toast.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: Direction of pointer swipe that should close the toast.

props.name: swipeThreshold
props.description: Distance in pixels that the swipe must pass before a close is triggered.

exports.name: ToastViewport
exports.description: Bottom right, above every overlay (z 100), full width on phones.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: The keys to use as the keyboard shortcut that will move focus to the toast viewport.

props.name: label
props.description:
An author-localized label for the toast viewport to provide context for screen reader users
when navigating page landmarks. The available `{hotkey}` placeholder will be replaced for you.
